matches.description: Offline validator for South American tax IDs: Argentine CUIT/CUIL (11-digit check digit algorithm), Chilean RUT (mod-11 check digit, 0-9 or K), and Colombian NIT (mod-11 verification digit with DIAN weights). Returns whether the check digit matches and a normalized/formatted value.

Validate the format and supported check-digit rules of tax IDs across Latin America and Spain: Chile RUT, Argentina CUIT/CUIL, Brazil CPF/CNPJ, Mexico RFC, Peru RUC, Colombia NIT, Spain NIF/NIE. Does not verify identity or registration with a tax authority. Use when checking a Latin American or Spanish tax ID's format before saving a customer or an invoice.
Spanish tax ID validation (DNI/NIF, NIE and company CIF) with check-digit verification. Computed locally; the ID is not stored.
Spanish tax ID validation (DNI/NIF, NIE and company CIF) with check-digit verification. Computed locally; the ID is not stored.

Valida el formato y el dígito verificador de un CUIT o CUIL argentino y devuelve su forma normalizada. El tipo puede declararse, pero no se deduce del número. La validación matemática no confirma asignación, titularidad, inscripción ni vigencia.
Validate and format a Chilean RUT (tax ID) including check digit (modulo 11). Use when a Chilean RUT is entered in a form or file and you must catch typos before saving.

Offline validator for a Guatemalan CUI (Código Único de Identificación), the 13-digit national ID number. Parses the 13 digits into an 8-digit correlative, a 1-digit check digit, a 2-digit department code and a 2-digit municipality code, recomputes the check digit using the published weighted mod-11 formula (weights 2-9 over the 8 correlative digits, mod 11, 10→0) and compares it, returning validity plus the parsed components.

Offline validator for a Romanian CUI (company tax ID). Strips an optional 'RO' prefix, applies weights 7-5-3-2-1-7-3-2 to the digits preceding the check digit (right-to-left), sums the weighted products, multiplies by 10, takes mod 11 (mapping a remainder of 10 to 0), and compares the result to the supplied check digit.
Validate tax identification number (TIN) formats for 40+ countries. Checks format rules and checksum algorithms where applicable. Does not verify with tax authorities.

note: Ranked deterministically: cosine similarity bucketed to whole percentage points (80.3% and 80.5% tie), then trust score, then described-before-undescribed, then endpoint id. Matches below a 0.5 similarity floor are dropped. A missing description carries no fixed malus: the endpoint is embedded via service name + URL path tokens (typically lower similarity), and the only deterministic penalty is losing the tiebreak when bucket AND score are both equal. score/grade are null when the endpoint is not yet scored. No verdict or flag detail here: POST /v1/x402-trust carries those per endpoint.
